scenes.text: Red emergency lighting. Helix Station shudders. You are alone in Lab Seven — your crewmates' last known position is three sections away, and the airlock timer reads 18:00.

choices.text: Head for the crew quarters immediately

scenes.text: The corridor is sealed at junction B-4. A pressure door, rated for deep vacuum, stands between you and your crew. The manual override requires a maintenance code.

choices.text: Look for the maintenance code in the wall panel
Head back to the mainframe for the code

scenes.text: The mainframe is still online. Station logs show a hull fracture in section C expanding at 2mm per minute. The maintenance code for B-4 is in the system — but so is something else: an anomalous signal on a loop.
The door grinds open. Your crew — two engineers, one medic — are suited up and waiting. 'We thought you were dead,' says Yara. 'Airlock in twelve minutes. Move.'

choices.text: Reroute via the cargo hold to grab emergency pods

scenes.text: The signal resolves into a voice: distorted, but human. 'Maintenance sub-level. Trapped. Please.' The sub-level is a four-minute detour — time you do not have to spare.

choices.text: Go to the mainframe and check if it is a recording loop
Accept the risk — head to the sub-level

scenes.text: The airlock cycles. All four of you seal into the escape pod. The station groans behind you as the hull fracture reaches critical. The pod fires.

choices.text: Set course for the nearest relay beacon
Broadcast a distress signal and wait

scenes.text: The cargo hold has three single-person escape pods — enough for everyone. But the route adds six minutes you do not have. You reach the pods with two minutes left on the airlock.

choices.text: Launch in separate pods — safest option
Abandon the pods — sprint to the main airlock

scenes.text: Sub-level access: a teenager, a stowaway, in a survival suit two sizes too big. 'My dad works at the relay beacon. He can help.' You have eight minutes left.

choices.text: Take her to your crew at B-4
Guide her to the cargo pods and meet your crew at airlock

scenes.text: The relay beacon picks up your pod within the hour. A rescue shuttle is two hours out. You watch Helix Station fold inward on the scanner — gone in seconds. Everyone made it.
The distress signal bounces off a passing freighter. They divert. Rescue takes four hours in the cold dark of the pod. When the hatch opens, the crew of the freighter applauds.
Three pods, four lives — one pod takes two. They scatter like seeds in the void. Seventy-two hours later, all three pods are recovered. The stowaway's father meets her at the dock.
The airlock seals behind you but the pod fails to launch. Hydraulic fault. You are sealed in, alive, as the station dies around you. The emergency beacon activates automatically.
